days.mission_in: Count your steps from one gate to the next.
days.entry: Dad counted his steps from the school gate to the next gate, about two hundred. There is a bus stop in between, and there is a neem tree there. A chana wala was standing at the bus stop.

days.mission_in: You will notice the sound near the school gate.
days.entry: Dad gave me a small packet, roasted chana. The neem at the bus stop was full of crows. The school bus went past.

days.mission_out: Listen for one bird you can hear from the path.

days.mission_in: Listen for one bird you can hear from the path.
days.entry: Dad was out for a walk today. There were many vehicles on the road, maybe there was a jam ahead. He walked on the footpath and did not go very far.

days.mission_out: Look at the colour of the sky above you.

days.mission_in: Look at the colour of the sky above you.
days.entry: Dad saw a bird with a long tail on the school wall. It flew off before he could see properly. He was on a walk today.

days.entry: Dad was out for a walk today. He mentioned that under the neem tree, there was no chickpea today. The crows were there again. The wind was cold, and it felt good.

days.entry: Dad went to the bus stop and came back. Today was nothing special.

days.entry: Dad was out today. He mentioned that some kind of poster was put up on the school gate, and he could not read it without his glasses. He also noted that the chana seller was back at the bus stop.
